references.text: The context for this passage, which describes Israel's journey along the Arnon River at the border of Moab
The preceding verse quoting from the Book of the Wars of the Lord and mentioning Waheb in Suphah and the valleys of the Arnon
The Lord gave Ar to the descendants of Lot as a possession, which explains the significance of Ar at the border of Moab
Moses describes the boundary at Ar in Moab during Israel's journey
The prophecy against Moab mentioning Ar, the same city referenced in Numbers 21:15
